summary: Sandbach United are in full swing preparing for the 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, having welcomed several exciting new signings and one returning player to the squad. Recent pre-season action has been mixed, with a solid 4-1 victory over Cammell Lairds offset by a narrow 1-1 draw against higher-league Longlevens, but the squad is building nicely ahead of their promotion push. The club is also actively seeking kit sponsorship opportunities and looking to fill some exciting roles within the organization.
